t: The Erbauer 70mm Multi-Material Holesaw is a high-quality cutting tool designed for trade professionals. Featuring a durable M3 bi-metal construction and steel body, it ensures reliable performance across various tasks. HSS teeth with varied pitches deliver a smoother, cleaner cut through materials such as wood, laminate, sheet metal, and plastic. This versatile holesaw is ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders working on installations requiring precise 70mm holes. A 38mm cutting depth and slotted barrel design aid efficient debris removal, making it suitable for use with 1/2 inch chucks.
b: Cuts Wood, Laminate, Sheet Metal & Plastic
Steel Slotted Barrel to Aid Removal of Debris
For 1/2" Chucks - Use with Pilot Drill
Durable M3 Bi-Metal & Steel Body Construction
HSS Teeth & Varied Pitches for Smooth Cuts
